<Heading as={"h1"} className={"openapi__heading"}>
  {"Delete runtime backup state"} <MarkerAddedInVersion version="8.10" />
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/backups/runtime/state"}
  context={"endpoint"}
></MethodEndpoint>

<MarkerStronglyConsistentExtension />

Resets the runtime backup state of every partition of the physical tenant, clearing
all checkpoint info, backup info, checkpoint metadata, and backup ranges. Used when
switching backup stores.

<MarkerRequiredPermissions
  permissions={[{ resourceType: "BACKUP", permissionType: "DELETE" }]}
/>

<ParamsDetails parameters={undefined}></ParamsDetails>

<RequestSchema title={"Body"} body={undefined}></RequestSchema>
